The recomposition of part of the reduced JKK to JKP (Pasal 9) does not change the total employer premium entering gross income, so it is not modelled.

output.reason: Employer-paid JKK contributions are added to the gross income of permanent employees for PPh 21. This regulation halves the JKK rate for every risk group (e.g. 0.24% to 0.120%, 0.54% to 0.270%, 0.89% to 0.445%, 1.27% to 0.635%, 1.74% to 0.870%). It applies to certain labour-intensive industries with at least 50 active BPJS participants, for contribution months February to July 2025. This changes the JKK benefit that enters PPh 21 gross income for those employees.
